'''Z-Omega group''' was a group of [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] that served the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|military]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. It was present at the [[Destruction of the Glory]].
